title: Mail reminders
subtitle: Every run of the reminder engine, what it analysed and the mails it produces.

principle.title: How the engine picks who to remind
principle.body: The engine does not remind everyone: it caps invitations at {margin} % of the free seats of each session and keeps the highest priority users. The same user is never reminded more than once every {days} days.

stats.executionsHint: including {count, plural, one {# simulation} other {# simulations}}

actions.openDetail: Open the detail of run no. {number}

simulation.title: Run a new simulation
simulation.notice: Simulation mode · no mail will actually be sent
simulation.description: The simulation replays the reminder algorithm on today's data to show who would be reminded, on which sessions and with which priority score. Nothing is written to the mail queue.
simulation.launched: Simulation started (demo), no mail was sent

empty.noRun: The reminder engine has not run yet.

detail.summary: This run analysed {analysed} users. {eligible} eligible (including {newcomers} newcomers). {seats} seats over {sessions} sessions. {mails} mails to send (fill rate {fillRate} %). {excluded} excluded.
detail.summarySimulation: This simulation analysed {analysed} users. {eligible} eligible (including {newcomers} newcomers). {seats} seats over {sessions} sessions. {mails} mails would have been sent (fill rate {fillRate} %). {excluded} excluded.
detail.noMailNotice: Simulation: no mail was sent, this run only shows what the algorithm would have done.
detail.failedBody: The engine stopped before prioritisation: no distribution is available and no mail was produced.

priority.title: Priority distribution
priority.hint: Split of the {count} eligible users by score category. The higher the score, the sooner the user is reminded.

criteria.newNoMail: Never validated the training, never reminded, no booking
criteria.newWithMail: Never validated but already reminded at least once
criteria.expired: Validity over, the score rises with age
criteria.expiringSoon: Still valid but expires in less than {days} days
criteria.regular: Up to date, or without history

priority.empty: No eligible user on this run.

exclusions.title: Exclusion distribution
exclusions.hint: Why {count} users were dropped before prioritisation.
exclusions.empty: No user excluded on this run.

unassigned.title: Unassigned users
unassigned.hint: {count} eligible users no session could take.
unassigned.empty: Every eligible user was attached to a session.

notFound.title: Run not found
notFound.description: This run does not exist or was purged from the history.

funnel.title: The engine steps
funnel.hint: How the engine goes from every user to the sent mails

analysed.label: 1 · Users analysed
analysed.hint: Every user known when the run started

excluded.label: 2 · Excluded upfront
excluded.hint: VIP, valid training, recent mail, booked slot, no email, inactive

eligible.label: 3 · Eligible
eligible.hint: Kept after exclusions, then ranked by priority score

assigned.label: 4 · Assigned · mails produced
assigned.hint: One slot per person, invitations = free seats x {margin}

unassigned.label: 5 · Unassigned
unassigned.hint: No compatible slot could take them

slots.title: Assignments per slot
slots.hint: Invitations sent slot by slot: free seats x {margin}, rounded up

mailsPreview.title: Preview of the produced mails
mailsPreview.hint: Highest priority first: the score follows the guide's model (new 1000, expired 400 to 799, expiring soon 200 to 399)
mailsPreview.footer: Preview of the first {shown} mails out of {total} produced by the run

descriptions.vip: Marked VIP: deliberately excluded from the automatic relance system
descriptions.validTraining: Their training is still valid, no need to chase them
descriptions.recentMail: Already received a relance mail within the last {days} days
descriptions.bookedSlot: Already registered to a future slot, no need to chase them
